verdict.rationale: Greptile's core product is an autonomous background automation: it automatically reviews every PR on trigger (docs-1, docs-5), runs sandboxed runtime checks via TREX without user intervention (docs-19), auto-routes reviews by agent-author detection (docs-27), and lets teams configure triggers, strictness, and custom rules to shape ongoing autonomous behavior (docs-20, docs-21, docs-22). Community evidence (comm-8) corroborates it catching real issues autonomously in production PR workflows, though other community reports (comm-4/5/6/7) note reliability/error issues in adjacent search features (not this automation flow directly). Missing for 10: independent verification of uptime/reliability specifically for the PR-review automation loop, and evidence of other automation types beyond PR-triggered review/TREX.
